# All thirty. Absence of any one of these fails the embedder's library load
# outright, so every one is checked by name. Enumerated from the embedder's
# binding rather than reconstructed here, and every name verified present in a
# built payload's export table before landing.
#
# Two entries that look odd and are not:
#
#   servo_rendering_context_create_software is required while create_native is
#   optional. It is the fallback surface and the one entry point that cannot
#   itself depend on ANGLE having loaded. It is also the older of the two, so an
#   older payload has software and not native, which is exactly the direction
#   the optional class exists to tolerate.
#
#   servo_webview_take_screenshot is load-bearing beyond its name: it is how the
#   embedder distinguishes "the engine is not drawing" from "the engine draws
#   and nothing is presented".
servo_builder_build
servo_builder_create
servo_builder_free
servo_builder_set_event_loop_waker
servo_builder_set_options
servo_builder_set_preferences
servo_free
servo_options_create
servo_options_free
servo_options_set_config_dir
servo_options_set_debug_option
servo_options_set_hard_fail
servo_options_set_multiprocess
servo_options_set_sandbox
servo_preferences_create
servo_preferences_free
servo_preferences_set_bool
servo_rendering_context_create_software
servo_rendering_context_free
servo_setup_logging
servo_spin_event_loop
servo_webview_builder_build
servo_webview_builder_create
servo_webview_builder_free
servo_webview_builder_set_delegate
servo_webview_builder_set_url
servo_webview_free
servo_webview_load
servo_webview_paint
servo_webview_take_screenshot
